weights.label: Total roll
weights.help: per cm the marble rolls, all branches

weights.label: Shortest branch
weights.help: per cm of roll on the shortest start-to-exit path

weights.label: Switchbacks
weights.help: per rail lying right under a route rail of the same type, reversed

weights.label: Triangle bases
weights.help: per triangle base (a plate tying two side rails, carrying the median)

weights.label: Columns on the base
weights.help: per column of the build standing on the triangle base's rails

weights.label: Ground columns
weights.help: per column standing on the ground (a triangle base's own excepted); 0 = off

weights.label: Frame turns
weights.help: per drop in the longest run turning the same way (the marble circling a frame)

weights.label: Shared towers
weights.help: per spot where columns hold two or more rails one above the other

weights.label: Stacked columns
weights.help: per column standing on a rail

weights.label: High exits
weights.help: per unit of height the marble leaves from (all exits)

weights.label: Weak towers
weights.help: per stack of 5+ blocks braced along one axis

weights.label: Idle rail
weights.help: per cm of rail the marble never rolls on (braces excluded)

weights.label: Unused area
weights.help: per cm2 of top view taken by parts no marble rolls on

weights.label: Footprint
weights.help: per cm2 of the bounding box in top view

style.label: Max rails
style.help: rails in one build, braces included

style.label: Overhang margin (g)
style.help: a rail with a load outside its supports keeps at least this on the lighter support

style.label: Highest block exit (u)
style.help: a branch may end at a block outlet only this low

style.label: Brace weak towers
style.help: lay marble-free rails across weak towers

style.label: Seesaw diamonds
style.help: chance to end a dive on a seesaw whose arms merge on a collector rail (search bias)

style.label: Base: triangle
style.help: weight of the isosceles triangle base in the draw (0: never)

style.label: Base: seesaw diamond
style.help: weight of the seesaw split-and-merge base in the draw

style.label: Base: none
style.help: weight of builds without a base design (the plain search)

style.label: Frames
style.help: chance to start a frame (the marble circling a rectangle); only from 45 levels

style.label: Switchbacks
style.help: chance to land on a reversed rail right under the one above (back and forth between two towers)

style.label: Align from depth
style.help: switchbacks and alignment start below this many drops (branch first above it)

style.label: Solve supports
style.help: re-solve the columns the marble never touches for all rails at once (fewer parts, slower)

style.label: Generation
style.help: top_down: grow the route down from the input (base drawn by lottery); bottom_up: place the triangle base first and grow the route up from it

style.label: Bottom-up base
style.help: what a bottom-up build grows from: the triangle base, or a ladder between two towers

style.label: Exits
style.help: contained: block outlets or dives only; any: rails may also roll off their end
